# Teacher model source

`internvl_chat/` contains the Python model and training sources used by the
paper-specific teacher runtime, together with pure-PyTorch point-cloud operator
fallbacks. It preserves the server implementation from source revision
`39647f66c5b9bacb308023344f95939e95133308` and remains separate from MIMA's
general-purpose `MLLM/internvl_chat` implementation.

Original copyright headers and file-level terms are retained. See the
[InternVL MIT license](internvl_chat/LICENSE) and MIMA's
[third-party notices](../../../docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
This directory contains source code only.
